summary: MGE Energy and subsidiary Madison Gas and Electric filed an 8-K reporting amended and restated revolving credit agreements dated October 1, 2026, extending maturities to October 1, 2031, with two optional one-year extensions to 2033. One MGE facility with JPMorgan Chase as administrative agent increased aggregate commitments from $90 million to $210 million; MGEE's facility stays at $50 million with a $25 million accordion. Terms, covenants and defaults are substantially unchanged. This is a routine financing/credit-facility event, not a special situation; watch for drawn balances and refinancing risk.
